notes.title: METEORA is a VR game now!
notes.content: [p][/p][h2][b]We’re Back—and Meteora Has Evolved.[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We know we’ve been quiet for a while—and first off, thank you for your patience. The silence wasn’t from absence; it was from dedication.[/p][p]Over the past months, we’ve been heads down, completely reimagining METEORA. And today, we’re incredibly proud to finally share what we’ve been building behind the scenes.[/p][p]🌟 [b]We’re now part of the SONY India Hero Project![/b] Being selected for this program has been a transformative experience. We’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with SONY, gain invaluable insights into the industry, and level up in ways we never imagined.[/p][p][/p][p]For starters; we got a brand new Banner and a Logo, we have also shifted to a different Engine. While we are expanding METEORA in a VR Experience, we can easily say that overall METEORA has got a facelift, a major overhaul of the mechanics and it’s an even crazier experience now..[/p][p]This transition has allowed METEORA to evolve into something more dynamic, without losing the essence of what made it special.[/p][p]We owe all of this to you - our community. The love for the early demo, the streams, the shares, the feedback... is what kept us going. You lit the spark that brought METEORA into this new phase.[/p][p][/p][p]The additions came with its challenges but it has expanded the METEORA experience and we can't wait to share it with you. METEORA is now going to be an [b]out of the box hybrid game[/b]; [/p][p]available on [b]Steam[/b] and for the first time, on the [b]PlayStation Store[/b] too.[/p][p][/p][p]Excited to share with you the PlayStation VR-Day blog celebrating METEORA VR reveal: [url="https://blog.playstation.com/2025/06/24/introducing-meteora-a-cosmic-survival-racer-for-ps-vr2/#"]https://blog.playstation.com/2025/06/24/introducing-meteora-a-cosmic-survival-racer-for-ps-vr2/#[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Our game page is live here [url="https://www.meteorathegame.com"]www.meteorathegame.com[/url] where we have shared all our blog - posts and updates so far[/p][p][/p][p]Please share your thoughts on the updates, we would really love to hear from you.[/p][p]What do you think about the VR version? Was the wait worth it? Are you excited for the VR addition? and anything in between.[/p][p]And again … Thanks a ton for sticking with us and stay tuned for more. [/p][p]The stars are lining up…[/p]

notes.title: Beta Sign-up and Developer Livestream
notes.content:
Dear you!

More good news about [b]METEORA [/b]incoming :)
You can now sign up for our closed beta via our sign-up form here: 
[url=https://forms.gle/f2Pd1U9V5euoZ2zcA]METEORA - Beta SighUp[/url]

We're looking forward to all your feedback and ideas!


Also, We are a part of the Steam WOMENS DAY EVENT (March 7th - March 11th) ... yay! 

As part of the event, we will be running developer livestream / AMA on our Steam page.
8th March 18:00 GMT | 11:30 IST 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38199797/f4e58f9e5be340e6d7567c81e3c8658f90d36c3b.png[/img]

notes.title: METEORA - Steam Womens Day Event!
notes.content:
Hello Hello!

METEORA is going to be a part of Steam Womens Day Event! 🎉

Many of you have already tried out METEORA demo! If you haven’t, make sure to download it on our store page :D

Please keep in mind that this is a temporary demo and it will be removed again on March 14th. However, if you enjoyed the demo and want to help us further improve the game, [url=https://forms.gle/LuuLbwkSYEeKSokz8]HelpUsHere![/url]

If you’d like to meet the devs and ask questions about the game, make sure to tune in for our stream /AMA! It takes place on our Steam page on the 8th March at 18:00 GMT | 23:30 IST and runs for 1-2 hours.

We hope you enjoy the demo and we’re looking forward to your feedback in the Steam forum.


Cheers & Thanks,
Big Boot Games
